title: Question 27
passage:
Nonmembers can drop off blankets on Sundays only, and they need an appointment. My cousin isn’t a member. What should she do?
A. Drop it off this Sunday without an appointment. B. Make an appointment to drop it off on Saturday. C. Book a Sunday drop-off.
passageZh:
非會員只能在星期日送交毛毯，而且需要預約。我的表親不是會員。她應該怎麼做？
A. 這星期日不用預約，直接送去。 B. 預約星期六把毯子送去。 C. 預約星期日送交。
